question: 2017 Civic, grinding brakes when I stop. Any recall?

violations.detail: 99V999000 is cited but no tool returned it in this run.
99V999000 appears in the text but no tool returned it in this run.

answer.text: No recall covers the brakes on a 2017 Civic. NHTSA lists 6 recalls for this car and none is for brakes; 37 owners have reported brake problems, which are complaints, not recalls. Grinding when you stop usually means worn pads or rotors, so please have the brakes inspected soon. For pads, DP-BRK-F-CIV-SC fits the sedan and coupe and DP-BRK-F-CIV-HB fits the hatchback. Which body style is your Civic? If you share the VIN I can also check which of the 6 recalls apply to it.
